title: Separate two independent clauses
instructions: Choose the only revision with two complete clauses and a valid boundary.

parts.prompt: Original: “The science club tested the filter twice the second result was clearer.” Which revision is correct?

options.text: The science club tested the filter twice, the second result was clearer.
The science club tested the filter twice; the second result was clearer.
Although the science club tested the filter twice. The second result was clearer.
The science club testing the filter twice; the second result was clearer.

choice_rationales.A: The comma still joins two independent clauses without a conjunction.
choice_rationales.B: A semicolon correctly separates the two closely related independent clauses.
choice_rationales.C: Although makes the first group dependent, and the full stop leaves it as a fragment.
choice_rationales.D: Testing is not the finite verb needed to complete the first clause.

parts.hint: Both sides can stand alone. Choose a boundary that can separate independent clauses.
parts.correct_explanation: The semicolon creates a valid boundary between two closely related independent clauses.
